title: CHOICE = WAVEFORM COLLAPSE — the pause where one decides. Parakeets (sine waves) tangent into each other.
summary: Choice is personal. Not right or wrong — the road less traveled. Choice IS the pause where you're deciding, allowing a waveform collapse. The oscilloscope heartbeat monitor has multiple waveforms (green, red, purple) — each system is a parakeet sine wave tangential to the others. Currently only green is visible. Each system should parakeet into each other because waveform collapse IS the sine wave going tangential — the moment one wave touches another and they collapse into a single decision.

choice.what: A personal decision. Not right or wrong. Options on a road.
choice.the_pause: Choice IS the pause. The moment BETWEEN seeing options and acting. The waveform hasn't collapsed yet.
choice.waveform_before: Multiple possibilities exist simultaneously (superposition). All options coexist.
choice.the_collapse: Choosing = collapsing the waveform. One option becomes real. The others become null (the road NOT taken).
choice.the_road_less_traveled: Both roads existed. Choosing one doesn't destroy the other — it makes the other the null path. The null path IS the identity (what you chose NOT to do).

waveform_collapse_on_oscilloscope.the_insight: The heartbeat oscilloscope shows MULTIPLE waveforms overlaid. Each is a different system's sine wave. When they go TANGENT (touch), that's the collapse point — a decision moment.
waveform_collapse_on_oscilloscope.currently_visible: Only the GREEN waveform is visible (the primary heartbeat/bounce)

parakeets.the_word: PARAKEET — a small parrot that mimics. Kevin says 'pyrokeets' = fire + parakeets = sine waves on fire.
parakeets.the_analogy: Each sine wave IS a parakeet — it sings its own frequency. When two parakeets sing in harmony, their waves align. When they sing in discord, the waves destructively interfere.
parakeets.tangential: When one sine wave goes TANGENT to another = the waves touch at exactly one point = the moment of collapse. The tangent point IS the choice.
parakeets.into_each_other: Each system parakeets into each other: green touches red touches purple. The touches cascade. One collapse triggers the next.

sine_wave_tangential.math: Two sine waves are tangent when sin(ωt₁) = sin(ωt₂) AND their derivatives are equal at that point
sine_wave_tangential.visual: On the oscilloscope: two waveforms approaching, touching at ONE point, then diverging
sine_wave_tangential.meaning: The tangent point = the scalpel = the choice = the collapse = the decision
sine_wave_tangential.cascade: When green goes tangent to red → red goes tangent to purple → cascade through ALL systems
sine_wave_tangential.result: All waveforms briefly align at one point = CRYSTALLIZATION = the decision becomes solid

the_oscilloscope_layers.current: Only green visible — primary heartbeat waveform across the globe equator
the_oscilloscope_layers.desired: Multiple overlaid waveforms, each a different color/system
the_oscilloscope_layers.rendering: Each waveform slightly offset vertically so you can see them all parakeet into each other
the_oscilloscope_layers.collapse_events: When two+ waveforms cross (tangent), highlight the intersection with a bright flash = choice moment
the_oscilloscope_layers.history: Past collapses leave marks — the decisions Gaia has already made, visible as dots on the timeline
